about.registryInfo: AgriDex International Limited — UK private company, headquartered in London, founded 2020 by Henry Duckworth (CEO). Operates AGRI token on Solana (existing tokenization marketplace, ~$28.5M post-money valuation per 2024 strategic round led by Portal Ventures) and is launching the Trade Float Vault on Stellar/Soroban under the consumer brand "Loam" (getloam.io). Backed by Endeavour Ventures, Portal Ventures, and others. Loam is positioned as a settlement layer for global agricultural trade with ~5s settlement and <0.5% fees.
